Why_this_title: Current App Store markets offline progress; current 2026 play log estimates offline rewards at ~4% of active and ~32% even after 8x ad, while frequent Chairman claims accelerate active play.
What_to_learn: For an idle-management product, explicitly measure active vs offline progression ratio and ensure the advertised idle fantasy remains credible.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not create a hidden requirement to keep the device awake for competitive/offerwall-viable progression.
Evidence: CURRENT US STORE + CURRENT SECONDARY PLAYER MEASUREMENT

Why_this_title: Freecash bonus deadlines drove aggressive early spend and screen-on behavior in the observed cohort.
What_to_learn: Tag acquisition source and external reward conditions before using progression/payer cohorts as product benchmarks.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not treat offerwall users as organic or normal paid-UA cohorts.

Why_this_title: Player guide reports cash-equivalent Gem/event rewards scale with current tenant revenue, encouraging players to hoard rewards until after upgrading.
What_to_learn: Audit whether reward EV depends on claim state; decide whether strategic timing is intentional or creates opaque optimization.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not assume nominal reward quantity equals player value across progression states.

Why_this_title: Tracked player prioritized Parking Spaces and CEO Desk over room Frames because the first two were perceived as broader progression utility.
What_to_learn: Separate local/cosmetic sinks from account-wide utility sinks in hard-currency design and reporting.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not use emotional worker-happiness pressure to hide weak sink efficiency.
Evidence: CURRENT 2026 PLAYER STRATEGY + CURRENT REVIEW COUNTER-EVIDENCE

Why_this_title: From Meow Bay onward the surface building fund pattern repeats while internal facility upgrade costs rise, producing slower progression.
What_to_learn: Track effective cost-to-next-goal, not only visible unlock thresholds.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not let repeated UI thresholds obscure escalating internal cost without recovery/clarity.
